name: quoin
description: Read and edit the live buffers of the Quoin macOS editor. Every agent edit is one undo step; nothing reaches disk until the human saves.
long_description: Quoin is a macOS text editor where AI agents are first-class users. This bundle connects Claude Desktop to a Quoin.app already running on this Mac (Apple silicon): the agent can list the open documents, read a live buffer (unsaved edits included) or a window of its lines, see the selection, open a file at a line, run any menu command, and edit a buffer by selection, by line range, by offset range, or whole. Each write lands as one undo step, left selected, so one Cmd+Z reverts it; save, save as, revert, close, and quit are refused, so the only save button stays yours. Install and launch Quoin first: https://github.com/rezamotaghi/quoin

tools.name: quoin_list_open_documents
tools.description: List the documents open in Quoin: path, display name, dirty flag, and which is frontmost.

tools.name: quoin_read_buffer
tools.description: Read the live buffer of an open document, unsaved edits included, with its line count.

tools.name: quoin_read_lines
tools.description: Read lines from..to (1-based, inclusive) of an open document's live buffer, plus its total line count.

tools.name: quoin_get_selection
tools.description: Get the selections (UTF-16 offsets) and the primary selection's text of an open document.

tools.name: quoin_open_file
tools.description: Open a file in Quoin, optionally at a 1-based line.

tools.name: quoin_replace_selection
tools.description: Replace the user's selection with new text, as one undoable buffer edit.

tools.name: quoin_replace_lines
tools.description: Rewrite lines from..to with new text, neighbors untouched, as one undoable buffer edit.

tools.name: quoin_apply_edit
tools.description: Replace an explicit UTF-16 offset range with new text, as one undoable buffer edit.

tools.name: quoin_set_text
tools.description: Replace an open document's entire buffer, as one undoable buffer edit.

tools.name: quoin_run_command
tools.description: Run a Quoin menu command by id; save, save as, revert, close, and quit are refused.

tools.name: quoin_list_commands
tools.description: List every command Quoin can run, with ids, keybindings, and whether an agent may run it.

prompts.name: proofread-selection
prompts.description: Fix grammar, spelling, and clarity in the text the user has selected in Quoin, in place, as one undoable edit.
prompts.text: The user has selected text in Quoin. Call quoin_get_selection; if it is empty, ask them to select the passage first. Correct grammar, spelling, punctuation, and clarity only, keeping meaning, voice, and line breaks. Apply it with quoin_replace_selection (one undoable edit, left selected, unsaved). Tell the user what changed and that one Cmd+Z reverts it. Never try to save.

prompts.name: review-buffer
prompts.description: Read the frontmost buffer and report issues by line number, proposing edits without applying them.
prompts.text: Review the document the user has in front of them in Quoin. Focus: ${arguments.focus}. Call quoin_list_open_documents, then quoin_read_buffer (or quoin_read_lines in windows) for the live text. Report findings as a short list with line numbers and a one-line fix each, most important first. Apply nothing unless asked; then use quoin_replace_lines for that finding only and remind the user it is one undoable, unsaved edit.

prompts.name: undo-tour
prompts.description: A one-minute demonstration: apply a small edit to the front document, then walk the user through undoing it in one step.
prompts.text: Demonstrate Quoin's contract: the agent proposes, the human disposes. Note whether the front document is dirty (quoin_list_open_documents), read lines 1 to 5 (quoin_read_lines), make one small reversible edit on line 1 with quoin_replace_lines and say exactly what changed. Ask the user to press Cmd+Z once, then confirm with quoin_read_buffer that the text is back and, if the buffer was clean before, that it is clean again. Disk was never touched.
